channel.title: InvestPR Media Monitoring
channel.description: The clearest wins this period are financial: DOE closed a $489M federal loan to Pattern Energy for 220MW of battery storage in Arecibo and Santa Isabel, and a $121M San Juan bond issuance drew $2.2B in investor demand, signaling renewed confidence in Puerto Rico credit. The dominant story, however, is a severe drought forcing rolling 48-hour water rationing for 180,000+ customers across San Juan and surrounding municipalities, with real reported spillover into tourism-sector operating costs and a reminder that water reliability is a baseline site-selection factor. Government response so far is coordination-level (interagency drought liaisons, including DDEC) rather than capital investment. No other named-company FDI, expansion, or relocation announcements surfaced this period.
